title: Tame Moduli of Life: Sharp O-Minimal Finiteness for Repair-Closed Systems and Tropical Walls over the Landscape of Physical Laws
description: A theoretical preprint proposing a conditional finiteness framework for finite-dimensional families of repair-closed systems. It encodes a model-relative admissibility predicate in an o-minimal structure, explains format-degree bounds under sharp o-minimality, and overlays tropical candidate walls. A synthetic semialgebraic example and reproducible numerical checks are provided. This is not an empirical demonstration or a universal classification of life.
